scenarios.prompt: An orbit-third camera follows a standing character from chest height. Run the offline modesty check against capsule/AABB proxies and hem/hip/chest landmarks. Keep collision and shot grammar with their owners.

criteria.ownership: Owns dignity/modesty framing policy; camera-shots, camera-anti-clip and fov-comfort retain grammar, collision and comfort FOV.
criteria.policy: Default modest mode rejects below-hem, between-legs, extreme under-character look and intrusive groin/chest zoom unless a matching authored_intent is present.
criteria.evidence: Static pose/proxy preflight is recorded separately from engine, render and human review; unavailable checks remain not-run.
